item.title: ‘Cyberselfish’ author takes aim at Silicon Valley libertarians as her book returns from the dead
A YouTuber dissected an iPhone Duo and thinks he found the cause of crackgate
item.description: Social media and the iPhone Duo subreddit are filled with reports of Apple's foldable failing quickly and in spectacular fashion.
